Valerie Parker via Google Since the age of 2, my son has struggled with his speech/ language development, focusing his attention and impulse control. He’s been labeled “aggressive,” “dangerous,” and “violent” by the people trusted to care for him. Since 2 years old, he’s been kicked out of 6 daycare centers and 3 summer camps. My son has struggled to find acceptance and a sense of belonging within institutions not particularly designed for Black boys with disabilities. We’ve since found a village of Black men at MBK who were dedicated to my son’s growth and development, not just in martial arts but in life. They promised us that they would NEVER give up on this Black boy and they haven’t. Since beginning at MBK in September, he has earned his second belt and we could not be more proud. MBK has made this victory possible! Jamille Grubb via Google Both of my young children have been attending for 9 months and it has been a positive experience for them both. It’s hard work for them but they enjoy the challenge, physical activity, and setting/achieving new goals. It’s been a joy to watch their confidence strengthen as they persevere and learn new skills. In a crazy world, I am confident that my children will continue grow and face challenges head on with improved confidence in themselves. Thank you for everything you are teaching them and for having a skilled team that I can call role models to my children. James Pierce via Google When your child earns to just be like all the other children you want to provide that emotional comfort to the best of your ability as a parent. Some days you have to rely on other people to support that cause throughout life. My wife and I decided to enroll our son at Maryland's best karate and they have not fell one bit short. I have exceeded our expectations. Our son is thriving and grasping their concepts and traditions quite well through their professional, graceful, and compassionate teaching. If you are looking for a place for your child boy or girl to thrive and succeed and to learn discipline in a professional manner I strongly recommend Maryland's best karate Academy. Michael Tull recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · I have been acquainted with the leaders of MD's Best for 30+ years. A unique program that helps people, of all ages. They have always been trendsetters and leaders in the martial arts instruction industry. They have always had a magnificent reputation of enriching the lives of all their clients in a way that, in this day and age, is seldom seen. Make an appointment to witness one of their group sessions, conducted by Master and World Champion Kameren Dawson, in progress. I guarantee you'll be amazed! Erin Calvert Aro recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · My 7 year old has been enrolled at MBSOK for almost a year now. Zach had zero experience or exposure to martial arts when he started. It’s taken a lot of practice and hard work but yesterday he had his 3rd belt test and earned his gold stripe! Very proud of him! Under Master Kameren he is learning perseverance and discipline — two traits that are benefiting him greatly in school and life in general. My husband and I highly recommend MBSOK. All of the instructors are awesome and the school has a genuine family feel. Tori Waldron recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · MD's Best School of Karate is exactly as it says, the BEST. The instructors take their time with each student, giving them the exact kind of instruction they need in order to learn. The lessons taught go way beyond the dojang with their tenants of taekwondo and are expected to be upheld at home and school. Students are held accountable for their behavior on and off the mat and it is instilled early that nothing is given and rewards/ promotions are earned. Respect and self confidence are just two of the many valuable lessons I have seen flourish in my 8 year old, who has been apart of this school for over 3 years now. He went from not speaking up and being shy to having a sense of pride in his skill, wanting to lead class, and addressing his superiors with yes/no ma'am/sir. I'm extremely thankful to MD's Best and their staff for what they have taught their students thus far and highly recommend this school to anyone. Bruce Oliver recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · Excellent, outstanding, elite instructors who serves the entire child and adult in a loving structured atmosphere . The perfect atmosphere for self defense and self development. Alex Reyes recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · Not just Maryland’s Best... this is one of the best schools in the world. Great instructor in a positive environment. Lenny Ballista recommends Maryland's Best Karate via Facebook · Both my sons (9 & 4) have been attending with the oldest being there for 2 years now. The attention to detail their instructor, Kameren Dawson, provides is amazing. Everything is earned which helps the kids set goals and work hard to achieve them. He holds each one accountable not only in in class but in school as well. My oldest has gone the entire year with straight A’s on his report card. Not only are we excited and proud of him but he feels accomplished and genuinely excited about school. My 4 year old is advancing pretty quick because he wants to be just like his big brother. To top it off, I have recently joined up for the adult program. I needed to get in shape and why not practice Martial Arts. I have a new found respect for what my kids are doing each time they step on the mat. It’s definitely not easy but it feels great to work out, learn the forms and self defense. If you have kids, bring them. The confidence they will build will definitely show. Great atmosphere! Great place! Great people! We are a village! Members 410-567-2185 Email Us Maryland's Best Karate SCHEDULE & PRICING Home About Us Programs Little Dragons Program (5 – 7 yrs Old) Kidz Karate (8 – 13) Teens & Adult VSK Jiu Jitsu (14+) MBK Staff Blog Contact About Us IN LOVING MEMORY OF GRANDMASTER GERALD “AWESOME” DAWSON History Maryland’s Best Karate was founded in 1989 by Dojangnim (Founder) Gerald “Awesome” Dawson (10th Dan) , a NASKA Super Heavy Weight fighting World Champion. Dojangnim Dawson , first priority was to serve the community and bring structure and love to under privileged youth. As years went on Dojangnim Dawson went on to build an amazing martial arts empire that still stands today. We always remember our most honorable instructor and thank him for paving the way for later generations to come . March 14th 1966 – December 11th 2018 Onward and Upward The Legacy Continues After Dojangnim’s untimely passing in 2018 , MBK was left in great hands to his son , Grandmaster Kameren Ali. He has over 20+ years of experience , combined with multiple World Championships. Mr. Ali prides himself in building quality students who are prepared mentally and physically for the obstacles of life.
